name: Headhunter’s Staff, Greater
body:
Aura moderate divination; CL 9th; Slot none; Price 48,600 gp; Weight 4 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

Resembling the headhunter’s staff in appearance, this staff can be used to produce an effect as the commune spell cast by a 9th level caster three times per day. These items usually use a god that possesses the Death domain as their source of information.

A positive response to the bearer’s question will cause the female head to wail, while a negative answer will cause the male head to shout. Both heads on the staff will speak if the answer to the commune is a short phrase or word.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, commune; Cost 24,300 gp.
